doc: The ONE table of which ground role (open, earth, rock, path) each base tile group (MAPG number) of each god's land plays. Read by bake_ground_roles.py. 'neighbours' = the group has no role of its own: its cells take the majority role around them. verified=false is NO VERIFICADO: decided by the script (bake_ground_roles.py --infer) from the height bands and the use on the imported maps, and waiting for a human to look at it. The lands of persephone, james and charnel come from the former land_themes.py NATIVE_ROLES / JAMES_ROLES; pyro and stratos were inferred by the script and checked by the user with a role sheet (each group's texture and where it falls on its map) on 2026-10-25.

persephone.source: land_themes.NATIVE_ROLES (James open/earth/low ground/rock -> MG3/MG4/MG2/MG1) and the use of tu02

0.why: near-white tile 0000, the filler under void cells (land_themes build_atlas comment)

2.why: grey-green earth around the grass; the former low ground / pale paths role

3.why: grass, the largest group of tu02

5.why: lowest band, 1 tile, blends only with MG4 (pair 4-5)

james.source: land_themes.NATIVE_ROLES comment (James MG00/01/02/03) and base_mapping for the groups with no band

path.why: Charnel's land has no path group; a Charnel look worn on a map with paths shows MG02 there, the group the former classic atlas (land_remap of High Noon) gave James's path MG02 (062-3a)
